text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to build ability 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume grow substantially over the 
summer. That is why Tracen Academy hosts 
training camps for focused conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's make this a great training 
camp!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm gonna be strict with you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's just what I want! Once summer 
is over, the Shuka Sho is right around the 
corner—
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I won't go easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To see that magnificent view, I have to 
secure our victory. I'll do my best!
choice_data_list:
(...From the looks of it, she doesn't seem 
anxious.)

(...From the looks of it, she doesn't seem 
anxious.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Buena Vista pumped herself up, the 
vulnerability felt after the Oaks was 
gone. ...Was it just my imagination after 
all?
choice_data_list: （……見た感じ、不安はなさそうだな）
（……見た感じ、不安はなさそうだね）
choice_data_list_en: (...From the looks of it, she doesn't seem worried.)
(...From the looks of it, she doesn't seem worried at all.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Good day, Buena-san♪"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan, good day!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could it be... you're in a super good 
mood?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thanks to you, I'm feeling wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This summer, I intend to push myself 
further... plunge into hardship... and 
hone my strength."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
――Far enough to reach "That Place." It 
means fulfilling her destiny as a Saint...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: By surpassing you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...It is an honor to compete against you 
in the 'Shuka Sho' as well. Please take 
good care of yourself."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Desire-chan. Somehow... she felt 
different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In fact, word has it that she's been 
undergoing ferocious training ever since 
the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks).
choice_data_list: ああ……雰囲気が研ぎ澄まされてるな
うん……雰囲気が研ぎ澄まされてるね

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah...
choice_data_list: ……あの子も大きく成長しそうだな
……あの子も大きく成長しそうだね
choice_data_list_en: ...Looks like that girl's going to grow a lot too.
...Looks like that girl's going to grow a lot too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (—Surpassing you.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ――…… *phew* ……*sigh*……

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, the luggage! I'll go bring it over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing carrying in our luggage 
for the training camp, we decided to take 
a stroll around the area first to build up 
our motivation.
choice_data_list: Still, it really is hot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Really...! We have to be careful of 
heatstroke!"
choice_data_list: しかし、さすがに暑いなぁ
choice_data_list_en: Man, it really is hot today, though.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The temperature should have cooled down a 
bit more by the Shuka Sho, but... we can't 
let our guard down, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something feels slightly off about her 
responses... Yet Buena Vista's expression 
remains bright. Though a bit bothered, I 
continue making small talk.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's true! The strategy changes 
depending on the course, too.
choice_data_list: その頃には海の色合いも変わってそうだな
その頃には海の色合いも変わってそうだね
choice_data_list_en: The colors of the ocean will probably have changed by then, too.
The colors of the sea will probably have changed by then, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto Racecourse has a short home stretch 
too... With my usual late-charging style, 
there's a chance the frontrunner might 
escape, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be great if I could switch 
strategies smoothly while running, but... 
if that's the case—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: 今はレースのことで頭がいっぱい？
choice_data_list_en: Is your head completely full of the race right now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, was I... just talking normally?
choice_data_list: (I see... So she doesn't even realize it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about the race... 
No, is feeling like I'm overthinking it a 
sign of a change in my mindset? What 
sparked it was—
choice_data_list_en: (I see... So she's not even aware of it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After talking with her, Buena Vista showed 
a hint of her helpless, uneasy demeanor. 
But... I tilted my head. Was that really 
it?
choice_data_list: （さっき……レッドディザイアと話したな）
choice_data_list_en: (She was talking to Red Desire earlier...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's a highly sensitive Umamusume. When 
strongly influenced by the surrounding 
atmosphere, her emotions can be deeply 
shaken.
choice_data_list: （大事なのは、ブエナが何を感じたか……）

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean by that...
choice_data_list: ディザイアは、どう違って見えた？
choice_data_list_en: How did Desire look different to you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Her aura is sharp and honed... There's 
that, but there's also—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—"Passionate!" ...is kind of the feeling, 
I guess.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Desire-chan's 'I won't lose!' 
feeling reaches me... it feels like a 
burst of flames roaring up inside." Pieter

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I feel like I felt the same thing at 
the racetrack, too.
choice_data_list: Could it be, after the Yushun Himba?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When everyone's cheering voices come 
together as one—
choice_data_list: もしかして、『オークス』の後？
choice_data_list_en: Could it be after the Oaks?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It flared up all at once inside my heart! 
A burning flame...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Right... That's why...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho, I think you should get 
more actively involved in the race's pace. 
Instead of just biding your time—"
choice_data_list:
(...I see, I think I'm starting to 
understand.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The thing influencing Buena Vista... It 
is—"intense excitement." The excitement of 
the audience, the Umamusume... of 
everyone.
choice_data_list: （……なるほど、わかってきたかも）
choice_data_list_en: (...I see, I think I'm starting to get it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The craze at the Oaks was on a whole 
other level. Swept up by it, I'm leaning 
forward far too eagerly—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Trainer. For the Shuka Sho, I 
want to take the initiative more 
aggressively! Positioning further ahead, 
or even running from the front—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having a strong fighting spirit isn't a 
bad thing, but... The hype leading up to 
the Shuka Sho will likely be greater than 
ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Caught in such intense excitement, Buena 
Vista would surely... lose her composure 
and fail to run as she wants.
choice_data_list: (I want to help her relax somehow, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her usual deep breaths probably won't cut 
it. She needs something that can blow away 
all the excitement pent up in her body—
choice_data_list: （なんとか肩の力を抜きたいけど……）
choice_data_list_en: (I need to loosen up somehow, but...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! Buena-san, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hello!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's the same every year, but it really is 
scorching hot around here~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know it must be tough, but do your best 
with your training! I'll bring back some 
souvenirs for you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm cutting training camp a bit short 
this year to head back home to Hokkaido♪
choice_data_list: お土産って……どこかに行くのか？
お土産って……どこかに行くの？

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! Hokkaido, you say...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds lovely~. It looks so 
refreshing...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. It's a reward to myself for 
working hard on the front lines all this 
time! I'm gonna go and forget all about 
the sweltering summer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A burning-hot summer training camp—no, a 
not-so-hot summer camp is about to begin!
